answer: An copycat running 176 aliases hence needs 174 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are written down in summit, expire in bridge, and forge lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 21 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 3234 identities would post 1020 proofs and burn roughly 51 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
